description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Microsoft login now shows real-time progress for each authentication stage.
2. Language switching now takes effect immediately (Activities are recreated to apply the new language), no restart needed.
3. Launcher/version settings pages now group related items with secondary-theme-color dividers; about page links merged into groups. Added a dark-mode primary theme color, and settings page action buttons are now icons.
4. The in-game menu is refactored into a RecyclerView multi-level menu.
5. The runtime installation page shows detailed per-file progress (e.g. which file is being copied).
6. Starting a game without a selected account now shows a prompt and jumps to the account management page.
7. Installer process communication switched to file polling with real-time log display; fixed hangs and wrong-process kills when creating installer processes repeatedly, with automatic retry on timeout.
8. The built-in browser now uses the default caching policy and no longer clears the cache on exit.
9. Fixed mod download location and recommended version not following the newly selected game directory.
10. Fixed view tree leaks after repeated installations (TaskDialog listener chain and temp-page animation callbacks), reducing accumulated jank.
11. Fixed version settings page input focus loss and a focus-advance crash on some custom ROMs.
12. Fixed key position offset after closing the layout editor, theme mode switching jank caused by spinner pseudo-callbacks, and default controller name display when not initialized.
13. Fixed an OOM in the modpack export file picker caused by accumulating listeners while scrolling, and a crash when external apps invoke modpack installation.
14. Fixed a race condition and NPE in cursor grab callbacks, FPS/memory display and sustained performance mode toggles not applied at game launch, and seek bars not persisting progress.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.微软登录实时显示各认证阶段进度
2.语言切换立即生效（重建 Activity 应用新语言），不再需要重启启动器
3.启动器/版本设置页设置项分组显示并带次要主题色分隔线，关于页链接行合并分组；新增深色模式主要主题色，设置页操作按钮改为图标
4.游戏内菜单重构为 RecyclerView 多级菜单
5.运行时安装页逐条目显示正在复制的文件等详细进度
6.启动游戏未选中账户时提示并跳转账户管理页
7.安装器进程通信改文件轮询，日志实时显示；修复多次创建安装进程时的卡死与误杀，进程超时自动重试
8.内置浏览器改为默认缓存策略，退出时不再清除缓存
9.修复切换游戏目录后模组下载位置与推荐版本未跟随新目录
10.修复反复安装后 View 树泄漏（TaskDialog 监听引用链与临时页动画回调），消除累积卡顿
11.修复版本设置页输入框失焦与部分定制 ROM 焦点移动崩溃
12.修复布局编辑关闭后按键位置偏移、设置页主题模式切换卡顿、版本设置页控制器未初始化时显示默认名称
13.修复整合包导出文件选择页滚动时监听器累积导致的 OOM 与外部应用调用安装整合包崩溃
14.修复游标抓取回调竞态与空指针、游戏启动未应用 FPS/内存显示与持续性能模式开关、进度条设置进度未保存等问题
